frames.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Edit reference image1 into ONE actual game animation PNG. Image1 is the accepted canonical camera and alien face/skin/clothing reference, image2 is the assigned limb pose diagram only. Keep the ENTIRE HEAD FACE EYE NECK AND TORSO of image1 at the exact same original position, apparent size, skin microtexture and lighting. Do not regenerate, enlarge, round or recenter the head. Repose only both arms and legs. True alpha background. Canvas 1086×1448 same as image1, no zoom/fit/crop. Actual baseline of image1 is y1375 for ground contact; use y1375 precisely for contacting toe, not bottom canvas y1448. The hip/belt remains at same height and x as image1. Red means permanent near foreground limb, blue far background limb. Real skin/clothing, no colors/bones/labels. Same olive sleeveless vest, cream undershirt, brown cargo pants, dark brown boots; large outer cargo thigh pocket stays on near leg, never transfers to far leg. Same gaze/expression/speckle pattern/eye shape. Every hand and boot inside canvas with at least64px lateral margin and64px below lowest foot. Independent two fists and two boots, no body crossing discontinuity. Return a single actual 3D rendered sprite, not sheet.
Phase3/12 airborne: NEAR pocket thigh and leg extend diagonally BACK/LEFT with boot above y1375; FAR thigh points forward/right high knee, shin hangs down, far boot also above y1375. NEAR upper arm near vertical down with elbow at waist and forearm forward/right at waist. FAR elbow behind torso, forearm folded strongly up/forward and far fist near chest above near fist. Two independently visible fists separated vertically. Keep canonical head/face/microtexture and torso from image1 EXACT same scale/location. Both feet airborne; do not plant them.

pixelBounds.definition: original bitmap alpha, before export padding/scale; opaque video borders are not sprite clipping

qa.notes: canonical重姿势头部尺度改善、两拳分离/两脚腾空；皮纹逐像素一致和全循环连续性仍不合格
